## Overview

1. **Gene panel check.** STARmap PLUS is a targeted panel (~2,800 genes). Keeps only the significant LR pairs from `03c` whose genes are all on the panel.
2. **Export for Python.** Log-normalizes the hippocampus object from `07` and exports expression, coordinates, metadata and the LR pairs for the bivariate Moran's I test

```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)

out_dir  <- file.path("output", "08_STARmapPLUS_CCC_GenePanelCheck")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
hpc_path <- file.path("output", "07_STARmapPLUS_ControlSpatialObject", "starmap_plus_control_seurat_hippocampus.rds")
```

## Load the significant LR genes

Complexes (`_`) are split into their subunit genes.

```{r load-lr-genes}

split_complex <- function(x) strsplit(x, "_")

sig_pairs <- read.csv(file.path("output", "03_RCTD_SpotDeconvolution", "significant_lr_pairs.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  distinct(spatial_pair, ligand_complex, receptor_complex)

lr_gene_sets <- purrr::pmap(sig_pairs, function(spatial_pair, ligand_complex, receptor_complex) {
  ligands   <- unlist(split_complex(ligand_complex))
  receptors <- unlist(split_complex(receptor_complex))
  unique(c(ligands, receptors))
})

significant_genes <- sort(unique(unlist(lr_gene_sets)))

cat("Significant LR gene set size:", length(significant_genes), "\n")
print(significant_genes)
```

## Load the STARmap PLUS hippocampus object

```{r load-hippocampus}

starmap_hpc <- readRDS(hpc_path)
cat("starmap_hpc:", nrow(starmap_hpc), "genes x", ncol(starmap_hpc), "cells\n")
```

## Merge SMC + Endo into "Vascular"

Matches the Visium reference, where SMC/pericytes/endothelial cells are one `Vascular` type. Stored as `celltype_merged`.

```{r merge-vascular}

starmap_hpc$celltype_merged <- starmap_hpc$top_level_cell_type
starmap_hpc$celltype_merged[starmap_hpc$celltype_merged %in% c("SMC", "Endo")] <- "Vascular"

cat("top_level_cell_type counts (before merge):\n")
print(table(starmap_hpc$top_level_cell_type))
cat("\ncelltype_merged counts (SMC + Endo -> Vascular):\n")
print(table(starmap_hpc$celltype_merged))

saveRDS(starmap_hpc, file.path(out_dir, "starmap_plus_control_seurat_hippocampus_merged.rds"))
```

## Gene panel overlap

```{r gene-overlap}

panel_genes <- rownames(starmap_hpc)

present_genes <- intersect(significant_genes, panel_genes)
missing_genes <- setdiff(significant_genes, panel_genes)

cat("Of the", length(significant_genes), "significant LR genes:\n")
cat(" - present in the STARmap PLUS panel:", length(present_genes), "\n")
cat(" - missing from the panel:", length(missing_genes), "\n\n")

# case-insensitive count: a big gap vs the exact match = capitalization mismatch
present_ci <- intersect(toupper(significant_genes), toupper(panel_genes))
cat("(Case-insensitive match count for comparison:", length(present_ci),
    "-- a gap between this and the exact-match count above points at a capitalization",
    "mismatch, not real absence.)\n\n")

if (length(present_genes) > 0) {
  cat("Present:\n")
  print(present_genes)
}
if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  cat("\nMissing:\n")
  print(missing_genes)
}
```

## Keep LR pairs with all genes on the panel

Every subunit of both ligand and receptor must be present.

```{r filter-sig-pairs}

gene_all_present <- function(complex_str) {
  genes <- unlist(split_complex(complex_str))
  all(genes %in% panel_genes)
}

ligand_ok   <- vapply(sig_pairs$ligand_complex, gene_all_present, logical(1))
receptor_ok <- vapply(sig_pairs$receptor_complex, gene_all_present, logical(1))

sig_pairs_present <- sig_pairs[ligand_ok & receptor_ok, ]

cat("LR pairs kept (both ligand and receptor fully present in the panel):",
    nrow(sig_pairs_present), "/", nrow(sig_pairs), "\n\n")
cat("Kept, by spatial_pair:\n")
print(table(sig_pairs_present$spatial_pair))
cat("\nOriginal, by spatial_pair (for comparison):\n")
print(table(sig_pairs$spatial_pair))

sig_pairs_present
```

## Cell-type vocabulary: STARmap PLUS vs. Visium reference

```{r celltype-vocab-check}

original_pairs <- unique(sig_pairs_present$spatial_pair)
cat("spatial_pair values in sig_pairs_present:\n")
print(original_pairs)

pair_celltypes <- strsplit(original_pairs, "-")
names(pair_celltypes) <- original_pairs

bad_splits <- pair_celltypes[lengths(pair_celltypes) != 2]
if (length(bad_splits) > 0) {
  cat("\nspatial_pair values that didn't split into exactly 2 tokens on '-' (check by eye):\n")
  print(bad_splits)
}

original_celltypes <- sort(unique(unlist(pair_celltypes)))
cat("\nCell-type vocabulary used in spatial_pair (the ORIGINAL Visium/RCTD/Jessberger-reference analysis, from 05-07):\n")
print(original_celltypes)

cat("\nCell-type vocabulary in starmap_hpc$top_level_cell_type (STARmap PLUS, raw):\n")
print(sort(unique(starmap_hpc$top_level_cell_type)))

cat("\nCell-type vocabulary in starmap_hpc$celltype_merged (STARmap PLUS, SMC+Endo merged to Vascular):\n")
print(sort(unique(starmap_hpc$celltype_merged)))

cat("\nCell-type vocabulary in starmap_hpc$sub_level_cell_type (STARmap PLUS, finer-grained):\n")
print(sort(unique(starmap_hpc$sub_level_cell_type)))
```

Apart from `Vascular`, the Visium cell types (`GC`, `Neurogenic_lineage`, `Cajal-Retzius`, …) have no direct 1:1 match in STARmap's labels and need a manual mapping before any cell-type-specific comparison.

```{r print-sig-pairs-detail}

sig_pairs_present |>
  arrange(spatial_pair) |>
  select(spatial_pair, ligand_complex, receptor_complex)
```

## Export the usable LR pairs

```{r export-sig-pairs}

write.csv(sig_pairs_present, file.path(out_dir, "sig_pairs_present_starmap.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Normalize and export for bivariate Moran's I

Log-normalization (`NormalizeData`) so Moran's I doesn't reflect sequencing depth.

```{r load-and-normalize}
starmap_hpc <- NormalizeData(starmap_hpc, verbose = FALSE)
cat("starmap_hpc:", nrow(starmap_hpc), "genes x", ncol(starmap_hpc), "cells\n")
```

All 4 sections are exported together with a `section_id` (`time` x `replicate`); the Python notebooks build one spatial graph per section.

```{r add-section-id}
starmap_hpc$section_id <- paste(starmap_hpc$time, starmap_hpc$replicate, sep = "_")
print(table(starmap_hpc$time, starmap_hpc$replicate))
```

Exported as matrix + CSVs and rebuilt as AnnData in Python.

```{r export-for-python}
export_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "starmap_hpc_export")
dir.create(export_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

norm_expr <- GetAssayData(starmap_hpc, layer = "data")  # log-normalized, genes (rows) x cells (cols), all 4 sections

Matrix::writeMM(norm_expr, file.path(export_dir, "expr_norm.mtx"))
writeLines(rownames(norm_expr), file.path(export_dir, "genes.txt"))
writeLines(colnames(norm_expr), file.path(export_dir, "cells.txt"))

coords <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(starmap_hpc, "spatial"))
coords$cell_id <- rownames(coords)
write.csv(coords, file.path(export_dir, "coordinates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

meta <- starmap_hpc@meta.data
meta$cell_id <- rownames(meta)
write.csv(meta, file.path(export_dir, "metadata.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# all panel-covered LR pairs (not restricted to a cell-type pair)
lr_pairs_export <- unique(sig_pairs_present[, c("ligand_complex", "receptor_complex")])
write.csv(lr_pairs_export, file.path(export_dir, "lr_pairs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("Exported to:", export_dir, "\n")
cat("Candidate LR pairs for the Moran's I screen:", nrow(lr_pairs_export), "\n")
```

## Notes

- Only LR pairs whose genes are all on the panel can be tested in STARmap PLUS.
